messages:
elaine-docs: PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 - updates migration guide, adds SDK snippet for Node v4. CI preview failed though, can someone take a look? :wave:

ci-bot: checks failing — docs-preview: failed, markdownlint: failed, vale: failed, linkcheck: 4 broken links. See details: https://ci.redwood/test/842/overview

matt-engineer: I can take markdownlint and the code fence issues. Which rules are tripping?

elaine-docs: markdownlint complains about MD041 (first-line-heading), and MD013 (line-length). Also got a vale alert about 'PassiveVoice' on the migration note. Linkcheck shows 404 on two external links and a relative path typo.

sam-reviewer: I'll handle linkcheck + spellcheck. @matt-engineer do you want me to wait for your fix before I review?

matt-engineer: I'm pushing a tiny commit in a sec to wrap long lines and add a heading. Will ping when pushed.

ci-bot: build log snippet:
```
ERROR: docs-preview failed to render /migration/upgrade-3-to-4.md: BrokenLinkError: 'https://example.com/old-sdk' returned 404
VALE: Rule 'PassiveVoice': 'was deprecated' in file migration/upgrade-3-to-4.md:23
MD013: Line length exceeds 120 characters at migration/upgrade-3-to-4.md:45
```

elaine-docs: thanks. Note: this PR also contains a new Node SDK snippet — if reviewers could sanity-check the code snippet is correct for the new client API that'd be great. @jordan-ux maybe quick glance for wording?

jordan-ux: will check wording. For merge timing: we should hold merge until tomorrow morning after the release window closes. Can we queue an approval but not merge?

sam-reviewer: yep I can approve and then convert to 'approved-waiting' label. We'll not merge until @release-manager gives thumbs up.

matt-engineer: pushed fixes in 1764310025, updated heading + wrapped lines. Also replaced the broken external link with archived redirect.

ci-bot: re-run started by matt-engineer. Status: markdownlint OK, VALE: one remaining 'Nominalization' warning, linkcheck: 1 broken (internal path '/sdk/node/old' -> should be '/sdk/node').

elaine-docs: oops that's my bad — I'll fix the relative path in a follow-up commit in a minute.

sam-reviewer: took the link fixes, patched spelling typos, and run local linkcheck. All green now except the nominalization Vale suggestion — it's stylistic, can ignore for now? :shrug:

jordan-ux: stylistic flag can be noted, but we should avoid heavy rewording in migration notes. Mark 'vale-ignore' inline if needed.

elaine-docs: done — added `<!-- vale: disable -->` around that sentence. CI rerun queued.

ci-bot: final status: docs-preview: passed ✅, markdownlint: passed ✅, linkcheck: passed ✅, vale: passed ✅. Approvals: sam-reviewer ✅, matt-engineer ✅. Waiting label: approved-waiting.

elaine-docs: thanks everyone. Tagging @release-manager for merge at 09:00 UTC tomorrow. :tada:
